description: Perceptual visual-regression diff. Paints a CIEDE2000 heatmap of what changed between two images (raster or SVG) and reports changed-pixel count/fraction, max & mean ΔE, and SSIM. Give an output path to save the heatmap.

candidate.description: Path to the image being compared; must match the reference size

reference.description: Path to the baseline image (raster or SVG)

threshold.description: CIEDE2000 above which a pixel counts as changed (default 2)

name: diff
